newsitem.title: JAPAN: Towa Real to get financial help, post profit - paper.
newsitem.headline: Towa Real to get financial help, post profit - paper.

text.p: Towa Real Estate Development Co Ltd will get financial support from its largest shareholder Fujita Corp and eight banks and is expected to post net profit in the year to March 31, 1997, after four years of losses, a Japanese economic daily reported.

The report, in the Monday edition of the Nihon Keizai Shimbun, said Fujita and the banks, including Tokai Bank Ltd 8321 T, would lower interest rates for the loans they extended to Towa, which was suffering from unrealised losses from its condominium business due to drops in land and real estate prices.

The paper said that due to the financial support Towa was going to receive, the company would post a parent net profit of about two billion yen in 1996/97 against a net loss of 6.21 billion yen in 1995/96.
The companies and banks were not immediately available for comment.
